meta.note: SUPPORTER-MASKEN-VERTRAUEN consumer (concept positionierung v1 5/6 + D4 + Ziel-Matrix Z6 'Offizier supportet statt zu raten'). The belief rail steers the supporter's TARGET CHOICE: trusted own section + exactly one FRESH hero anchor = strike ('Feuer in die richtige Sektion statt Bedrohungs-Schaetzung'); diffuse belief, sub-threshold belief, or anchor ambiguity = support (the decision names NO target - never a guessed one); the channel is null (canon runs bit-identical) below the mask-Verfeinerung-Rung (SectionSkill table S3/S4/S5), without the trust table, without a seeded belief, and whenever a FACT key (reaktion/wachzone/vergeltung) is in play - FAKT SCHLAEGT MASKE. Expect blocks recorded ONCE via --record and reviewed line by line; the laws are hand-pinned. NO pre-existing fixture touched (addition-only canon law).
